reason: I'm already paying OpenRouter 5.5% on top and then fighting my accountant every month because I have no VAT invoice, so a VietQR top-up with an automatic e-invoice and no fee fixes two real headaches. I'd take the 50k free credit, run it side by side with OpenRouter for a week, and move one project over if latency holds.
objection: It's one more middleman run by an unknown local team; if it adds latency or goes down, my product goes down with it, and I don't know how fast you are compared with OpenRouter's routing and fallbacks.
would_change_my_mind: If my side-by-side test shows noticeably worse latency or errors than OpenRouter, or the e-invoice doesn't actually arrive correctly with my company's tax code, I'd stop.
